fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the image load of "Python Core" by a non-Python process. This might be indicative of a Python script bundled with Py2Exe.
fields.name: Python Image Load By Non-Python Process
fields.query: event.type="ModuleLoad" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (Description="Python Core" and (not (src.process.image.path contains "Python" or (src.process.image.path contains "C:\Program Files\" or src.process.image.path contains "C:\Program Files (x86)\" or src.process.image.path contains "C:\ProgramData\Anaconda3\"))) and (not not (src.process.image.path matches "\.*"))))
